    "preconditions": "User is authenticated and has access to the Doorstop interface.",

Note: The actor/role and main/alternative/exception flow details were not provided in the original requirements, so they have been assumed based on typical use cases for a requirements management tool. The actor is considered a user with appropriate privileges. The main flow outlines the standard process for each requirement, while alternative and exception flows cover edge cases or errors. The JSON test cases now include all necessary elements, including IDs, requirement IDs, test types, preconditions, inputs, steps, and expected outcomes. The test cases also address the issue of unknown requirement IDs by expecting an error or exception when attempting to interact with them.
